papers.abstractEn: Drawing on interviews with thirteen fans, anti-fans, and bystanders, together with 139,795 Weibo posts and 205,001 comments surrounding the Cai Xukun controversy, this study identifies positioning, storytelling, affective attunement, and calibration as four affective practices. These practices explain how heterogeneous participants sustain movement-like collective participation after an external rupture.

papers.readingUse: 用于理论框架、研究设计或结果讨论。

papers.title: Hybridizing Tradition and Technology: Global Reception of ‘Black Myth: Wukong’ as a Vehicle for Chinese Cultural Identity and International Media Flows
papers.titleZh: 传统与技术的混融：黑神话悟空作为中国文化身份与国际媒介流动载体的全球接收
papers.authors: Yuan Gao, Jia Li, Jianping He
papers.takeaway: 研究以第三空间和文化混融为框架，结合游戏及副文本的批判话语分析与微博、Reddit、Steam受众话语的计算内容分析。最终清理出3842条相关用户内容，发现中国玩家更强调文化真实性、象征和叙事深度，国际受众更关注玩法、技术与可及性，并经常遗漏或误解文化细节。
papers.theory: 用文化混融、第三空间和全球媒介流动解释传统神话在全球游戏惯例中的再编码与不对称接收。
papers.data: 游戏文本与推广材料，以及2024年9月至11月微博、Reddit和Steam的3842条清洗后用户内容。
papers.method: 批判话语分析与计算机辅助内容分析，含主题模型、情感分析和平台比较。
papers.results: 国内外受众关注重点明显不同，国际受众的视觉和技术好评并不等于理解中国文化含义。
papers.limitations: 平台比较混合了国家、语言、平台可供性和用户自选择，自动情感分析难捕捉讽刺，不能识别个体因果机制。
papers.abstractZh: 研究以第三空间和文化混融为框架，结合游戏及副文本的批判话语分析与微博、Reddit、Steam受众话语的计算内容分析。最终清理出3842条相关用户内容，发现中国玩家更强调文化真实性、象征和叙事深度，国际受众更关注玩法、技术与可及性，并经常遗漏或误解文化细节。
papers.apaCitation: Gao, Y., Li, J., & He, J. (2025). Hybridizing tradition and technology: Global reception of ‘Black Myth: Wukong’ as a vehicle for Chinese cultural identity and international media flows. Global Media and China. Advance online publication. https://doi.org/10.1177/20594364251385203
papers.hypothesisImplication: 简报推论：国际受众的技术好评可能与文化理解脱钩，人物认同与传播意向也不应从总体情感自动推断。
papers.manipulationImplication: 简报推论：在同一人物材料中正交操纵文化解释深度和本国相似人物类比，并固定玩法与视觉质量。
papers.measurementImplication: 简报推论：分别测量事实理解、象征意义理解、人物好感、Schwartz价值契合、人物认同、分享意向和实际选择。
papers.abstractEn: Using third-space and cultural-hybridity perspectives, this study combines critical discourse analysis of Black Myth: Wukong and its paratexts with computational analysis of 3,842 relevant posts from Weibo, Reddit, and Steam. Chinese audiences emphasized cultural authenticity, symbolism, and narrative depth, whereas international audiences focused more on gameplay, technology, and accessibility and frequently missed or misinterpreted cultural details.

papers.title: What Can Cognitive Load and Processing Fluency Tell Us About Difficult Processing?
papers.titleZh: 认知负荷与加工流畅性能告诉我们什么：困难加工的实验检验
papers.authors: Elizabeth E. Riggs, Hillary C. Shulman, Richard Huskey, Teresa Lynch, Jacob T. Fisher
papers.takeaway: 实验在健康叙事中分别用听觉提示操纵反应性认知控制，以语言难度操纵加工流畅性。语言难度影响记忆与叙事说服；当语言困难时，听觉提示反而增强记忆，说明负荷与流畅性不能被视为同一维度。
papers.theory: 区分客观资源需求与主观加工困难，并检验两者对记忆和说服的交互作用。
papers.data: 单项健康叙事实验；可访问摘要未给出可核验的完整样本量。
papers.method: 听觉提示乘语言难度的实验设计，同时测量记忆和说服结果。
papers.results: 加工流畅性操纵影响记忆和说服；语言困难条件下听觉提示提高记忆。
papers.limitations: 证据范围以出版方摘要和可访问手稿为主，健康叙事与神话人物不同，样本结构需阅读全文复核。

papers.abstractEn: This experiment independently manipulated reactive cognitive control through auditory cues and processing fluency through linguistic difficulty in a health narrative. Linguistic difficulty affected memory and narrative persuasion. Under difficult language conditions, auditory cues improved rather than impaired memory, showing that cognitive load and processing fluency should not be treated as the same dimension of difficult processing.

papers.title: AI for Democracy? How Public Service Media Around the World Use Artificial Intelligence to Produce Journalism
papers.titleZh: AI能服务民主吗：全球公共服务媒体如何用人工智能生产新闻
papers.takeaway: 研究以调查、组织文件和高级管理者访谈比较非洲、亚洲、欧洲、大洋洲及加勒比地区13家公共媒体网络。AI主要用于转录、图像生成编辑和内容定制，效率与公共价值、法定义务和民主使命之间存在持续张力。

papers.method: 跨国调查、组织文件和高级管理者访谈的混合证据。
papers.results: 工具用途并不独特，时间与成本节约是主要驱动，但公共服务媒体面临更复杂的价值冲突。

papers.abstractEn: Using surveys, organizational documents, and interviews with senior managers, this comparative study examines artificial-intelligence use in thirteen public-service media networks across Africa, Asia, Europe, Oceania, and the Caribbean. AI was used mainly for transcription, image generation and editing, and content personalization. The findings reveal persistent tensions between efficiency, public value, statutory obligations, and democratic missions.

papers.title: Do Personal AI Conversations Reduce Loneliness? Evidence from a Pre-Registered Experiment
papers.titleZh: 与个人AI对话能减轻孤独吗：预注册实验的证据
papers.authors: Claudia Senik, Ariell Reshef, Louis Freget
papers.takeaway: 法国成年人的大规模预注册实验要求处理组连续28天每天至少进行一次个人AI对话。干预显著增加社会情感型AI使用，但主观孤独上升，其他福祉指标方向也一致不利，不过估计不精确。
papers.theory: 检验AI陪伴是否替代或挤出人际连接，并区分工具使用量与主观福祉。
papers.data: 法国成年人大样本；当前公开摘要未给出可核验的完整样本量。
papers.method: 预注册28天随机实验，处理组每日个人AI对话，对照组维持原状。
papers.results: AI使用增加并未减轻孤独，主观孤独反而上升；其他福祉结果方向不利但不够精确。
papers.limitations: SSRN工作论文尚未同行评审，允许参与者自行选择工具，使具体模型和对话内容异质。
papers.abstractZh: 法国成年人的大规模预注册实验要求处理组连续28天每天至少进行一次个人AI对话。干预显著增加社会情感型AI使用，但主观孤独上升，其他福祉指标方向也一致不利，不过估计不精确。
papers.abstractEn: A large preregistered experiment with adults in France required participants in the treatment condition to hold at least one personal conversation with an AI system each day for twenty-eight days. The intervention substantially increased socioemotional AI use but did not reduce loneliness. Self-reported loneliness increased, and other well-being measures moved in similarly unfavorable directions, although several estimates were imprecise.

papers.hypothesisImplication: 简报推论：来源披露、信息情绪性和辅助程度可能改变解释的可信度，但不应与内容理解效应混为一谈。
papers.manipulationImplication: 简报推论：若使用AI或第三方解释，正交操纵来源披露与辅助程度，并保持解释文本内容相同。
papers.measurementImplication: 简报推论：分别测量感知作者身份、真实性、信任、理解、人物评价和传播意向。
papers.abstractEn: This mini-review synthesizes thirteen core experiments and four adjacent studies on AI-mediated interpersonal communication. Relational costs of AI assistance were concentrated around four conditions: disclosure or suspicion of AI use, emotionality of the message, closeness of the relationship, and degree of assistance. Perceived authorship is proposed as a candidate mechanism, but the review notes that it has not yet been tested directly.

toc.title: The sequential replicant effect in interpersonal sincerity: evidence from AI-mediated apology and gratitude
toc.abstractZh: 两项预注册双轮实验发现，AI介入线索会稳定降低道歉与感谢信息的真诚感。先前被启动的AI介导意识还会通过提高AI使用怀疑，影响后来没有AI线索的信息判断，形成序列效应。
toc.abstractEn: Across two preregistered, two-wave experiments, cues that artificial intelligence had assisted with apologies or expressions of gratitude consistently reduced perceived sincerity. Making AI mediation salient in an earlier message also increased suspicion of AI use and shaped evaluations of a later message that contained no AI cue, producing a sequential replicant effect.

toc.title: The link between three smartphone school policies and students’ mental health: a growth trajectory approach
toc.abstractZh: 比利时三所学校实施不同手机限制后，研究以最多七轮调查追踪学生。首次测量时全禁学校的抑郁和焦虑最高，但三校心理健康变化轨迹没有显著差异；全禁和午餐可用学校内部的抑郁症状均上升。
toc.abstractEn: Students in three Belgian schools were followed for as many as seven survey waves after the schools adopted different smartphone policies. At baseline, depression and anxiety were highest in the school with a full ban, but trajectories of mental health did not differ significantly across schools. Depressive symptoms increased within both the full-ban school and the school allowing lunchtime use.

papers.title: Bureaucratic incentives shaped effectiveness of the one-child policy in China
papers.titleZh: 官僚激励塑造了中国独生子女政策的执行效果
papers.authors: Lingsheng Meng, Hanmo Yang, Grant Miller, et al.
papers.category: 综合顶刊推荐 · 社会科学
papers.takeaway: 研究显示，把官员晋升前景与出生指标挂钩的官僚激励强化了独生子女政策执行，并解释1990年代中国生育率下降的近一半。
papers.theory: 以组织激励和晋升约束解释同一政策在地方执行强度上的差异。
papers.data: 中国地方政策执行、官员激励和生育结果的历史行政数据。
papers.method: 利用一票否决激励强度差异进行政策效果识别；完整模型与稳健性需阅读全文核验。
papers.results: 更强官僚激励显著强化政策执行，并解释1990年代生育下降的重要部分。
papers.limitations: 宏观历史识别依赖制度差异和模型假设，摘要不足以核验全部机制与异质性。

papers.abstractEn: This study shows that bureaucratic incentives linking officials’ promotion prospects to birth-control targets strengthened enforcement of China’s one-child policy. Variation in these incentives helps explain a substantial share of the fertility decline during the 1990s, illustrating how personnel rules can shape the effectiveness of nationwide social policy.

papers.title: Foreign cultural norms are better accepted in the second language
papers.titleZh: 使用第二语言时，人们更容易接受外国文化规范
papers.authors: Jiehui Hu, Aina Casaponsa, Wanyu Zhang, Rafał Jończyk, Yan Jing Wu, Shan Gao, Guillaume Thierry
papers.venue: Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences, 1551(1), 257–269
papers.source: Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences
papers.takeaway: 20名中英双语者和20名英语母语者判断一般知识与中英文化规范句，并记录N400。一般知识的整合跨语言相似；双语者用英语时更接受英国文化规范，用中文时更接受中国文化规范，显式判断与神经指标共同支持语言情境效应。
papers.theory: 把语言运行情境视为文化特定语义知识的激活线索，而不只是翻译载体。
papers.data: 20名流利中英双语者和20名英语母语者。
papers.method: 文化规范乘语言的句子判断实验，结合接受度、反应时和事件相关电位N400。
papers.results: 双语者在第二语言英语中更接受英国文化规范，文化无关一般知识未呈同样语言差异。
papers.limitations: 样本仅40人且同质，双语者均在英国生活，语言与文化线索难完全分离，作者也要求更大样本复现。
papers.abstractZh: 20名中英双语者和20名英语母语者判断一般知识与中英文化规范句，并记录N400。一般知识的整合跨语言相似；双语者用英语时更接受英国文化规范，用中文时更接受中国文化规范，显式判断与神经指标共同支持语言情境效应。
papers.apaCitation: Hu, J., Casaponsa, A., Zhang, W., Jończyk, R., Wu, Y. J., Gao, S., & Thierry, G. (2025). Foreign cultural norms are better accepted in the second language. Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences, 1551(1), 257–269. https://doi.org/10.1111/nyas.15407
papers.hypothesisImplication: 简报推论：第二语言可能改变外国文化规范的可接受性，因此价值契合效应可能受到实验语言调节。
papers.manipulationImplication: 简报推论：在同一外国受众中随机呈现母语版与高质量第二语言版，并保持人物行为和价值信息一致。
papers.measurementImplication: 简报推论：同时测量接受度、理解、文化接近、价值契合、道德评价、反应时和可行的隐性加工指标。
papers.abstractEn: This study examined whether bilingual speakers accept cultural norms differently depending on the language in use. Twenty Chinese–English bilinguals and twenty English monolinguals evaluated general knowledge statements and British or Chinese cultural norms while EEG was recorded. General knowledge integration was similar across languages, whereas bilingual participants were more accepting of British norms in English and Chinese norms in Chinese. Explicit judgments and N400 responses therefore converged on a language-context effect in cultural norm acceptance.

papers.title: The Effectiveness of Adaptation of the Protagonist in Narrative Impact: Similarity Influences Health Beliefs Through Self-Referencing
papers.titleZh: 调整叙事主人公的有效性：相似性通过自我参照影响健康信念
papers.takeaway: 220人的组间实验操纵叙事主人公与读者的相似性。相似主人公提高受众对自身疾病风险与应对效能的判断，效应由自我参照中介。
papers.theory: 以自我参照而非笼统熟悉感解释主人公相似性如何影响叙事效果。
papers.method: 主人公相似与不相似的组间实验，并检验自我参照中介。
papers.results: 相似主人公提高风险感知和应对效能，自我参照解释这一差异。
papers.limitations: 这是较早的健康传播研究，主人公相似性不是跨文化神话类比，结果变量也不是人物认同。
papers.abstractZh: 220人的组间实验操纵叙事主人公与读者的相似性。相似主人公提高受众对自身疾病风险与应对效能的判断，效应由自我参照中介。
papers.apaCitation: de Graaf, A. (2014). The effectiveness of adaptation of the protagonist in narrative impact: Similarity influences health beliefs through self-referencing. Human Communication Research, 40(1), 73–90. https://doi.org/10.1111/hcre.12015
papers.hypothesisImplication: 简报推论：本国相似人物类比可能通过自我参照提高接收，但该路径与价值契合和文化熟悉性不同。
papers.manipulationImplication: 简报推论：比较无类比、表层相似类比和价值结构相似类比，并测量而非假定自我参照。
papers.measurementImplication: 简报推论：测量自我参照、感知相似、价值契合、文化熟悉、人物认同和叙事结果。
papers.abstractEn: A between-subjects experiment with 220 participants tested whether adapting a narrative protagonist to resemble readers increases narrative impact in a health context. Readers exposed to a similar protagonist perceived greater personal disease risk and greater efficacy in dealing with the symptoms than readers exposed to a dissimilar protagonist. Self-referencing mediated these effects, indicating that similarity made readers relate the story more strongly to themselves.
